newsitem.title: USA: Mesa Air furloughing pilot-school graduates.
newsitem.headline: Mesa Air furloughing pilot-school graduates.

text.p: Mesa Airlines said Monday it was sending furlough notices to 81 ground-school pilot graduates because of delays in gaining final Federal Aviation Administration approval for the company's Beechcraft 1900D simulator training program.

Pending that approval, Mesa, a division of Mesa Air Group, said it could not justify keeping the pilots on the payroll until they are cleared for their final simulator training and can become active flight crew.

Larry Risley, chairman and chief executive officer of Mesa Airlines said, "We anticipated a full conversion of our flight training to simulator training for some time now and have kept these employees on the payroll in anticipation of that training being approved."
Mesa said the furloughs will have little, if any, negative impact on its current training and line pilot shortage.
